concepts.def: Average mass of isotopes weighted by abundance
Arrangement of electrons in shells, e.g. 2,8,1
Percentage of each isotope in a sample
Equals electrons in the outer shell

walkthroughs.body_html:
Ar = (mass1 x abundance1 + mass2 x abundance2) / 100.

Chlorine has 75% Cl-35 and 25% Cl-37.

Ar = (35x75 + 37x25)/100 = 35.5.

Fill shells in order: 2, then 8, then 8.

Sodium (11 electrons) = 2,8,1. Outer shell = 1, so Group 1.

Three shells used, so Period 3.

Outer electrons = group number (1-7 and 0 for noble gases).

This is why Group 1 elements react similarly - all have 1 outer electron.

Noble gases (Group 0) have full outer shells: unreactive.
